title: Open Questions of the Canon Debate and the 2026 Election
grammar: Recap: indirect questions with -e and question words
goal: I can state the open questions of the canon debate before the election of 2026 (*jegyzék, szaktanár, előír*).
I can state an open question of the canon debate with *-e* or with a question word.
I can name the author who received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2025 and give the result of the election of 12 April 2026 (*Nobel-díj, mandátum*).
